criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Page size and all four margins match the house style in every section.
All text resolves to the house-style font through runs, styles and defaults; a font left to the theme is a different font.
Body text resolves to the house-style point size.

A Risks section after Recommendations says the checklist may raise the share of rejected applications in its first months and that scanning depends on the December budget decision.
